# 2026 Presidential Cycling Tour of Turkiye

The 2026 Presidential Cycling Tour of Turkey is a road cycling stage race that takes place between 26 April and 3 May 2026 in Turkey. It is the 61st edition of the Presidential Tour of Turkey.
Teams
Three UCI WorldTeams, fourteen UCI ProTeams, and six UCI Continental teams make up the 23 teams that participate in the race.
